Name: LOAD_BALANCER_PARAM_ST
Description: Graphics load balancer. While the frame rate stays low, a load level rises one step at a time; while it stays high, the level drops again. Each effect below has a level value: it is on while the load level is below that value and is turned off once the level reaches it. 0 = always off, 21 or more = never turned off.

Fields.Name: Low FPS Threshold
Fields.Description: If the FPS falls below this amount, then the load balancer level increases by 1.

Fields.Name: High FPS Threshold
Fields.Description: If the FPS exceeds this amount, then the load balancer level reduces by 1.

Fields.Name: Low FPS Threshold Count
Fields.Description: The load balancer level rises by 1 once this many frames in a row run below Low FPS Threshold.

Fields.Name: High FPS Threshold Count
Fields.Description: The load balancer level drops by 1 once this many frames in a row run above High FPS Threshold.

Fields.Name: Sleep Duration after Level Reduction
Fields.Description: The number of frames to ignore monitoring for after a load balancer level reduction.

Fields.Name: Sleep Duration after Level Increment
Fields.Description: The number of frames to ignore monitoring for after a load balancer level increment.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Light Shafts
Fields.Description: Load level at which post-process light shafts turn off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Bloom
Fields.Description: Load level at which bloom turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Glow
Fields.Description: Load level at which the glow post effect turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Anti-Aliasing
Fields.Description: Load level at which anti-aliasing turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Ambient Occlusion
Fields.Description: Load level at which screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO) turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Depth of Field
Fields.Description: Load level at which depth of field turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Motion Blur
Fields.Description: Load level at which motion blur turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Post Process: Motion Blur Iteration Reduction
Fields.Description: Load level at which motion blur uses fewer iterations. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Shadow: Blur
Fields.Description: Load level at which shadow blur turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Emitter Count
Fields.Description: Load level at which particle emit interval, emit count and LOD distance are set to half of the graphics config values. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Reflection
Fields.Description: Load level at which particle effects are no longer drawn in reflections. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Water Interaction
Fields.Description: Load level at which particle water-surface interaction turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Glow
Fields.Description: Load level at which glow from particle effects turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Distortion
Fields.Description: Load level at which distortion from particle effects turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Soft Sprites
Fields.Description: Load level at which soft sprites on particle effects turn off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Light Shafts
Fields.Description: Load level at which light shafts from particle effects turn off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Reduction - Particles: Render Distance
Fields.Description: Load level at which a scale is applied to the distance check that dynamically moves particle effects into the reduced-resolution buffer. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution
Fields.Description: Load level at which dynamic resolution starts working.

Fields.Name: Shadow Resolution: Cascade 0 (Half)
Fields.Description: Load level at which the resolution of shadow cascade 0 is halved.

Fields.Name: Shadow Resolution: Cascade 1 (Half)
Fields.Description: Load level at which the resolution of shadow cascade 1 is halved.

Fields.Name: Player: Disable Wetness (Local)
Fields.Description: Load level at which the local player no longer gets wet. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Player: Disable Wetness (Remote)
Fields.Description: Load level at which remote players no longer get wet. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Enemy: Disable Wetness
Fields.Description: Load level at which enemy characters no longer get wet. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution: Minimum %
Fields.Description: Lowest render resolution dynamic resolution may use, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution: Maximum %
Fields.Description: Highest render resolution dynamic resolution may use, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Particles: Cartridge Emittance Distance
Fields.Description: The distance at which cartridges will be generated, if the distance between the generation location and the camera is within this value. In metres.

Fields.Name: Particles: High Load FPS Threshold
Fields.Description: When the FPS falls to this value or lower, particle effects treat the game as being in a high load state.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution: Reduction Speed
Fields.Description: How quickly dynamic resolution lowers the resolution when performance is poor. Lower values drop faster.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution: Start Resolution
Fields.Description: Initial resolution percentage for dynamic resolution.
